retained_baseline_artifact.hash_scope: Complete private three-feature retained-baseline GeoJSON file; selected target identified by awId.

review.method: All selected retained-baseline parts plotted together and visually compared with official regional Figures1/9 and lower-corridor Figure52. No source vertices copied, no formal georeferencing or numerical match claimed.
observations: The selected route starts in the eastern interior, bends south and then west, traverses a long northwest-trending middle corridor, and turns north through the coastal plain.
That broad route shape corresponds to the survey main corridor through the Collier/Mount Egerton, Turee Creek, Wyloo and Onslow sheet areas.
The named lower-river map is consistent with the final northward corridor; separate northern tributary arms in the regional maps are not used as the identity of the selected main route.

limits: The comparison establishes representative river-system identity at regional scale, not a label for every line part.
The retained endpoint is a rendering endpoint; agreement with a source endpoint or present shoreline is not established.
Original HydroRIVERS coordinates were not acquired or compared; retained geometry is not asserted coordinate-identical to original data.
